title: Tommy Shelby vs Alfie Solomons — The Betrayal Gambit

opening.speaker: white
opening.label: Tommy
opening.evidence: Actual native opening frame at 692.50 s shows Tommy. The English soft timing reference at 692.56–694.239 s and local word-timed ASR confirm the payroll line before Alfie replies; this initial ungraded line defines White.

outro_summary: Tommy opens with information, Alfie replies with threats and a surprising concern for office furniture. The partnership turns into a takeover, then Tommy negotiates his way back out. Later, Alfie counters a betrayal accusation by attacking Tommy's moral exception. Neither man becomes trustworthy. They just get better at negotiating with the other one.
